source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.4 with Figs. 3.15 and 3.16 (PDF 65-66).

blocks.text: Be-wazan chhari ke sire se laga mass m lein (Fig. 3.15), pivot O par bearing raghrat se paak aur system ufqi satah mein. Chhari par amood mass par lagne wali force F use F = ma ke mutabiq tez karti hai, aur aisa karte hue mass ko O ke gird ghumati hai. Chunke tangential acceleration a_T angular acceleration alpha se a_T = r alpha ke zariye jura hai, F = m r alpha. Chunke ghumane ka asar torque tau se paida hota hai, gardish ki equation ko torque ke zariye likhna behtar hai, dono taraf r se zarb de kar: rF = tau = torque = m r^2 alpha, jo Newton ke doosre qanoon F = ma ka gardishi mutabiq hai: F ki jagah tau, a ki jagah alpha aur m ki jagah m r^2.

blocks.alt: Patla daira, markaz par pivot O aur O se dashed ufuqi lakeer. Grey chhari O se daire par mass m ki gend tak, dashed lakeer se zawiya theta oopar. Chhari ke saath naap ki lakeer us ki lambai r dikhati hai, aur gend par teer F chhari se seedha zawiya (right angle) banata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.15: Force F axis O ke gird torque paida karti hai aur mass m ko pivot ke gird angular acceleration alpha deti hai (kitab ki Figure 3.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Moment of inertia
blocks.text: Miqdar m r^2 moment of inertia kehlati hai aur I se zahir hoti hai. Moment of inertia angular harkat mein wahi kirdar ada karta hai jo linear harkat mein mass. Yeh sirf mass m par nahi balke r^2 par bhi munhasir hai.

Zyada tar sakht ajsam mein gardish ke axis se mukhtalif faaslon par mass ki mukhtalif miqdar hoti hai, to mass ki taqseem yaksan nahi. Fig. 3.16a ki tarah sakht jism gardish ke axis O se faaslon r1, r2, ... par masses m1, m2, ... ke n chhote tukron se bana hai. Jism angular acceleration alpha se ghoome; m1 par lagne wale torque ki miqdar tau1 = m1 r1^2 alpha hai, isi tarah m2 par torque tau2 = m2 r2^2 alpha, aur isi tarah aage. Bare sakht jism ke andar har chhota mass ka tukra pivot ke gird ek jaisa angular acceleration pata hai; chunke jism sakht hai, sab masses ek hi angular acceleration alpha se ghoomte hain. Kul torque tau_total = (m1 r1^2 + m2 r2^2 + ... + m_n r_n^2) alpha = (i = 1 se n tak m_i r_i^2 ka majmooa) alpha, ya tau = I alpha ... (3.18), jahan I jism ka moment of inertia hai, I = i = 1 se n tak m_i r_i^2 ka majmooa ... (3.19).

blocks.alt: Ek hi be-qaida sakht jism ke do manzar, neela rang, chhoti chokor masses m1, m2, m3 aur m4 dashed lakeeron r1, r2, r3 aur r4 se axis O se juri hain. (a) mein m2, O se guzarti dashed ufuqi lakeer par hai. (b) mein poora jism O ke gird ghoom chuka hai, aur kinare se bahar dashed lakeer ufuqi se zawiya theta banati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.16: Bare sakht jism ka har chhota tukra pivot ke gird ek jaisi angular acceleration rakhta hai (kitab ki Figure 3.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jism ghooma to har mass m1 se m4 apne apne faasle r1 se r4 par usi zawiya theta se ghoomi; (a) se (b) tak sab ki angular displacement, angular velocity aur angular acceleration barabar hai. Farq sirf faaslon ka hai, is liye kul torque = (m1 r1^2 + m2 r2^2 + ...) alpha = I alpha.

blocks.alt: Chaar ajsam, har ek ke markaz se amoodi axis AA'. (a) Lambai L ki patli chhari, axis beech se amood: I = (1/12) mL^2. (b) Radius r ka patla chhalla (hoop): I = mr^2. (c) Radius r ki thos disc ya cylinder: I = (1/2) mr^2. (d) Diameter 2r ka sphere: I = (2/5) mr^2.
blocks.caption: For Your Information (PDF page 66): axis AA' ke gird mukhtalif ajsam ke moments of inertia (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaaron ka mass m barabar ho to bhi moment of inertia mukhtalif hai, kyunke mass axis se mukhtalif faaslon par phaila hai. Hoop ka saara mass kinare (faasla r) par hai, is liye I = mr^2 sab se bara. Disc mein mass beech mein bhi hai, to (1/2) mr^2; sphere mein aur zyada mass axis ke qareeb hai, to (2/5) mr^2.
Barabar mass ke do cylinders mein se bare diameter wale ka rotational inertia zyada hai (Do You Know).

blocks.alt: Barabar mass ke do lakri ke cylinders, har ek par mura teer apne lambe axis ke gird gardish dikhata hai: oopar chhota magar mota (bare diameter wala) cylinder; neeche lamba patla (chhote diameter wala) cylinder.
blocks.caption: Do You Know (PDF page 66): barabar mass ke do cylinders; bare diameter wale ka rotational inertia zyada hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono ka mass barabar hai, magar mote cylinder ka mass axis se zyada door hai. Moment of inertia mass zarb faasle ke muraba (r^2) par munhasir hai, is liye mote cylinder ko ghumana ya rokna zyada mushkil hai.

blocks.prompt: 60 cm diameter ke 200 kg sphere ka moment of inertia kya hai (numerical problem 3.6)? Mass linear harkat mein inertia napta hai; gardish mein us ka mutabiq kya hai, aur woh sirf mass par kyun munhasir nahi (short question 3.4, MCQ 3.10)?
blocks.explanation: I = (2/5) m r^2 = (2/5) x 200 kg x (0.30 m)^2 = 7.2 kg m^2 (chhapa jawab 28.8 kg m^2 diameter 0.60 m ko r maanne se milta hai). Mutabiq moment of inertia I = majmooa m_i r_i^2 hai, jo angular acceleration ke khilaf muzahimat napta hai (tau = I alpha); yeh mass aur axis ke gird us mass ki taqseem par munhasir hai, kyunke har tukra m_i zarb apne faasle ka muraba deta hai.

items: Chhari par mass: F = m r alpha, to rF = tau = m r^2 alpha; F = ma ki gardishi shakal jis mein m ki jagah I = m r^2.

n tukron ka sakht jism, sab ka ek alpha: tau = I alpha (3.18), I = majmooa m_i r_i^2 (3.19); I mass aur axis se us ke faasle par munhasir. Chhari (1/12) m L^2, hoop m r^2, disc (1/2) m r^2, sphere (2/5) m r^2.
